newsitem.title: GERMANY: Baden-Wuerttemberg cost of living up 1.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Baden-Wuerttemberg cost of living up 1.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The statistics Office in the west German state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said on Thursday that the cost of living rose 0.6 percent in July from June, for an annual rate of 1.7 percent.
In June, the state reported a year-on-year rise of 1.4 percent and a month-on-month increase of 0.2 percent.

Data for four west German states are used to calculate a preliminary figure for Germany as a whole. Baden-Wuerttemberg was the last of the four states to report. All the state data showed living costs were notably higher in the month.
